translation.description: Run code with cat() sent to a file.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: File path or an open text file.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the sink is active.

arguments.name: split
arguments.text: Accepted. R would also copy the text to the previous sink.

translation.details: cat() writes to the sink instead of stdout. The file is closed afterwards. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
with_output_sink(path, lambda: cat("hello\n"))
with open(path) as handle:
    text = handle.read().splitlines()[0]
os.remove(path)
return text
